metadata.title: HRP maritime risk routing zones
metadata.disclaimer: Analytical voyage-planning aid only. JWC wording, IMO/IMB incident reporting and current security advice supersede this display. Not for navigation, insurance placement, or operational passage planning.
metadata.display_geometry: water-only polygons clipped against Natural Earth 1:50m land

properties.name: JWC: Arabian Gulf, Indian Ocean, Gulf of Aden and southern Red Sea
properties.description: Defined waters listed for Hull War, Piracy, Terrorism and Related Perils. Offshore control points follow JWLA-033; coastline closures are generalized for analytical display.

properties.name: JWC: Gulf of Guinea defined waters
properties.description: Waters from the Togo coast to 0°40'S, 3°E and east to Cape Lopez Peninsula, Gabon.

properties.name: JWC: Cabo Delgado defined waters
properties.description: Territorial sea of Mozambique and Tanzania between Mnazi Bay and Baía do Lúrio as defined in JWLA-033.

properties.name: JWC: Black Sea and Sea of Azov defined waters
properties.description: Black Sea and Sea of Azov waters defined by the JWLA-033 western and southern control points.

properties.name: Piracy watch: Somalia, Gulf of Aden and western Indian Ocean
properties.description: Analytical watch envelope for renewed Somali piracy capability and 2026 incidents. This is not a statutory or insurance boundary and the former industry Indian Ocean HRA was rescinded in 2023.
properties.source_title: ICC IMB piracy-prone areas and 2026 incident reporting

properties.name: Piracy watch: Straits of Malacca and Singapore
properties.description: Analytical watch envelope covering the Straits of Malacca and Singapore, where ReCAAP continued to report armed robbery incidents in 2026.
properties.source_title: ReCAAP ISC weekly and annual piracy reporting

properties.name: Piracy watch: Gulf of Guinea
properties.description: Analytical watch envelope for piracy and armed robbery risk in the Gulf of Guinea. Current incident levels are lower than historic peaks but crew-safety risk remains.
properties.source_title: ICC IMB piracy-prone areas and warnings
